exposure: Use of air filters in home
Parental atopy status (both atopic, one atopic, neither atopic)
cohort: 1497 newborns in a subtropical country, with follow-up data available for 1236 children at 3 years and 756 children at 6 years
finding: In children of non-atopic parents, a combination of Cesarean section and breastfeeding for more than 1 month was associated with the highest risk of atopic dermatitis, while living in homes with curtains and no air filters was associated with the highest risk of allergic rhinitis, and male infants living in homes without air filters had the highest risk for asthma.
mod_finding: Cesarean section combined with breastfeeding for more than 1 month was associated with the highest risk of atopic dermatitis.
country: Not specified, but described as a subtropical country
